polityNote: First-level units of the Kyrgyz Republic from the dissolution of the USSR (26 Dec 1991) to the eve of Batken oblast (13 Oct 1999; the Natural Earth fill draws from then). Atoms: geoBoundaries KGZ ADM1 (OpenStreetMap 2017, 7 regions, 29,257 vertices). The 1999 Osh oblast is the union of the 2017 Osh and Batken atoms. The 2010 district layer (Wikipedia) was rejected: it is coarser than the Natural Earth line (Naryn district 83 vertices for 8,001 km²). Chuy, Bishkek, Jalal-Abad and Naryn stay unresolved — the OSM 2017 Chuy atom contains Bishkek, and its Naryn atom contains Toguz-Toro district of Jalal-Abad. Check ① (geodesic area of the union against statoids’ areas at independence): Osh 45,979 vs 46,189 km² = 0.995; Talas 11,429 vs 11,446 km² = 0.999; Issyk-Kul 41,994 vs 43,144 km² = 0.973; the same measure exposed the Toguz-Toro error (Jalal-Abad 0.881, Naryn 1.053). OpenHistoricalMap carries only the country for these years.
